fact: Executive Decree 19-271, published in Journal officiel no. 63 of 9 October 2019, fixes the national interoperability referential defining the norms and standards for public information systems, which administrations must conform to and write into the specifications of systems they acquire or develop.
title: Journal officiel de la République algérienne n° 63 (Décret exécutif n° 19-271)
